subject: Notification: auth anomaly — request for IRP artifacts & SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Claire Atkinson <claire@shorebank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notification: auth anomaly — request for IRP artifacts & SOC 2 evidence

Claire —

I wanted to notify you directly: at ~04:15 UTC this morning our telemetry detected a short-lived spike in failed authentication attempts originating from a small set of IPs. The spike lasted ~7 minutes and triggered our automated rate-limiting and temporary lockouts. We have contained the activity; current indicators show no successful escalations and no data export.

Summary of actions taken so far:
- Automated throttles and account lock applied for affected tenants (04:16 UTC)
- Replayed auth logs to validate no successful token exchanges (forensics started 04:20 UTC)
- Blocked offending IPs at the edge and escalated to L3 (04:30 UTC)
- Rolled a short-lived service token and rotated the associated signing key (05:00 UTC)

We will produce a short incident-readout package for you including:
- Our current IRP (redwood_irp_v2.pdf) 
- A sanitized telemetry sample (telemetry_sample_20261003.tar.gz) 
- SOC 2 control mapping for this event (soc2_control_matrix.csv)
- A redaction index that shows what was removed for privacy (redaction_index.xlsx)

Before we share the package, can you confirm if Shorebank requires a signed legal copy / nondisclosure acceptance for the artifact bundle (some auditors request a DocuSign acknowledgment before ingesting logs)? If yes, we can send a DocuSign packet and/or a redacted set first.

I will follow up with an internal assignment to prepare the artifacts. Please let me know any specific time-window or fields you need redacted (PII, account IDs, etc.).

Respectfully,
Markus Klein
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (stub) redwood_incident_readme.txt (text/plain, 1.1KB)

---
From: Claire Atkinson <claire@shorebank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: security@shorebank.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Notification: auth anomaly — request for IRP artifacts & SOC 2 evidence

Thanks for the quick heads-up, Markus.

First — appreciate the containment steps. For Shorebank compliance we will need:
- The IRP you mentioned (PDF)
- A telemetry sample limited to auth events for the 7-minute window plus 15 minutes after
- The SOC 2 control mapping and any notes on control change that were exercised

Regarding legal acceptance: our audit team prefers a signed data-handback form (DocuSign is fine). If you can send the redacted set first (PII removed) and the DocuSign link, we'll have the auditors accept and then request the full logs under the signed agreement.

Also include a short timeline of discovery->containment->remediation with timestamps in UTC.

Claire Atkinson
Head of Information Security
Shorebank

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Notification: auth anomaly — request for IRP artifacts & SOC 2 evidence

Team — forwarding Shorebank's reply. Please treat this as time-sensitive. Tasks below: 

Marissa: produce a redacted IRP + short timeline. Use redwood_irp_v2.pdf as the base; add a one-page timeline in UTC and create redaction_index.xlsx identifying removed fields. Deliver by Monday EOD PDT.

Ben: assemble a sanitized telemetry sample containing auth events for window 2026-10-03T04:08:00Z -> 2026-10-03T04:30:00Z (7-minute spike + 15min). Remove any full account identifiers (hash instead), include event types, IP, geo, agent, timestamps. Put sample in telemetry_sample_20261003.tar.gz and checksum the archive. 

Naomi: produce the SOC 2 control mapping csv (soc2_control_matrix.csv) mapping the observed actions to controls (CC6, CC7, etc.), and confirm whether any compensating controls were exercised. Also prepare a DocuSign packet for Shorebank to sign that acknowledges receipt of the redacted artifacts and indicates next steps to request the full set.

Cc: this is low-severity but we need auditor-ready artifacts and a clear redaction trail. If legal needs to weigh in on the DocuSign wording ping me and I'll loop in Legal.

Thanks — Markus

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Claire Atkinson <claire@shorebank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notification: auth anomaly — request for IRP artifacts & SOC 2 evidence

Claire —

Thank you for the direction and the quick reply. Per your request we are sending the redacted artifact bundle and the DocuSign packet to accept the redacted set. Links/attachments below: 

Attachments included in this message (sanitized):
- redwood_irp_v2.pdf (IRP; redactions applied, see redaction_index.xlsx)
- telemetry_sample_20261003.tar.gz (sanitized auth-event sample; SHA256: 2f7a...b3c1)
- soc2_control_matrix.csv (mapping of actions to SOC 2 criteria)
- redaction_index.xlsx (detailed index of removed fields)

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/someDoc/sign/xyz123
Drive copy (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/irp-pack-20261003
HubSpot record: HS-23456

High-level timeline (UTC):
- 2026-10-03T04:15:00Z — anomaly detection (auth failure spike)
- 2026-10-03T04:16:00Z — automated throttles + rate-limit applied
- 2026-10-03T04:20:00Z — forensic replay and initial triage started
- 2026-10-03T04:30:00Z — offending IPs blocked at edge
- 2026-10-03T05:00:00Z — short-lived signing key rotated; remedial config applied

Notes on redaction: we removed cleartext customer PII and replaced account ids with HMAC hashes. The redaction_index.xlsx maps file->line->redaction reason. If auditors need additional fields redacted/unredacted, we can produce a tailored export after DocuSign acceptance.

Next steps we propose: 
1) Shorebank signs the DocuSign packet to accept the redacted artifact bundle.
2) Once signed, we will produce the full telemetry export under an approved SFTP window (estimated 48 hours after sign-off).
3) We will schedule a short readout call to walk the Shorebank audit team through the controls exercised (30 min). Please propose a time window.

If you prefer the artifacts via SFTP instead of Drive/DocuSign, tell us the preferred endpoint and we will push the sanitized bundle there.

Best —
Markus Klein
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
